message.title: Xplora Technologies AS: Mandatory Notification of Trade by Primary Insiders
message.body:
Oslo, 20 August 2026.

Cosimo AS, a company owned 100% by Trygve Bruland, who is a member of the
board and primary insider of Xplora Technologies AS (the "Company"), bought on
the 19 August 2026, 160,000 shares in the Company from Trygve Bruland
personally at a price of NOK 26.75 per share. Following the transaction,
Trygve Bruland's total combined direct and indirect shareholding in the
Company is unchanged at 660,000, of which 0 shares are owned by Trygve Bruland
personally, and 660,000 shares are owned by his company Cosimo AS.

Thomas Embla Bonnerud, member of the board and primary insider of Xplora
Technologies AS (the "Company"), bought 2,250 shares in the Company on 19
August 2026 at a price of NOK 26,75 per share. Following the transaction,
Thomas Embla Bonnerud holds 2,250 shares in the Company.

Jens Leth, COO and primary insider of Xplora Technologies AS (the "Company"),
bought 4,000 shares in the Company on 19 August 2026 at a price of NOK 26,86
per share. Following the transaction, Jens Leth holds 4,000 shares in the
Company.

Tomislav Krznari , Business Unit Director and primary insider of Xplora
Technologies AS (the "Company"), bought 4,000 shares in the Company on 19
August 2026 at a price of NOK 26,76 per share. Following the transaction,
Tomislav Krznari  holds 4,000 shares in the Company.

Kristin Hellebust, CLO and primary insider of Xplora Technologies AS (the
"Company"), bought on the 19 August 2026 and 20 august 2026, respectively,
2,950 shares in the Company at a price of NOK 27 per share and 2,500 shares in
the Company at a price of 25 NOK. Following the transaction, Kristin Hellebust
total combined shareholding in the Company is 81,193 shares in the Company.

This information is subject to disclosure requirements in Regulation EU
596/2014 (MAR) article 19 no. 3 and the Norwegian Securities Trading Act
section 5-12.

For further information please contact:
Sten Kirkbak, CEO, +47 92203710, sten.kirkbak@xplora.com
Knut Stålen, CFO, +47 92043458, knut.stalen@xplora.com

About Xplora Technologies AS:
Xplora Technologies is a Norway-founded, technology company creating smart
devices, services and communication solutions for children, youth and seniors
that keep families connected, safe, and balanced. The company's purpose is to
build a safer and healthier digital life for all generations. As the pioneer
of the kids' smartwatch category in Europe, Xplora Technologies today serves
the full spectrum of family needs from early childhood to later life, through
its two brands Xplora and Doro. The company positions itself as a family-first
organization and a trusted advisor for parents and caregivers throughout the
digital journey, delivering the right technology at the right time. Xplora
Technologies is headquartered in Oslo, Norway with operations in leading
European markets and North America. The company is listed on Euronext Growth
under the ticker XPLRA.
